name: Drainliar
summary: Larger and more formidable than a Familiar, this blood-feeding bat gathers in cave colonies and pursues intruders.

name: Drops
summary: An orange Poring relative adapted to desert heat, Drops still scavenges belongings left upon the ground.

name: Dustiness
summary: A moth protected by an unusually tough body, often encountered in dim places around Mount Mjolnir.

name: Eddga
summary: Forest communities revere this ancient pipe-smoking tiger, whose resentment grows as people destroy the mountains around him.

name: Eggyra
summary: A wandering egg creature whose thick shell conceals the life within as it drifts through dungeon passages.

name: Evil Druid
summary: Once a distinguished priest, this cursed undead carries a floating spellbook that crackles with supernatural energy.

name: Flora
summary: A rooted, sunflower-like predator that feeds upon travelers. Alchemists collect parts of this unsettling plant for their work.

name: Frilldora
summary: This desert lizard spreads a broad neck frill and catches insects with its long, quick tongue.

name: Ghostring
summary: A spectral Poring said to have returned through lingering resentment, its familiar outline changed by an unsettled afterlife.

name: Giearth
summary: An underground earth fairy devoted to gathering and working ore, with little patience for anyone disturbing its possessions.

name: Hode
summary: A giant desert worm that retreats beneath the sand, concealing its considerable length from passing travelers.

name: Horn
summary: Usually peaceful, this large beetle relies on its scissor-like jaws when something threatens it.

name: Horong
summary: A violet death-fire associated with wandering spirits. Accounts agree on its eerie glow, while its origins remain uncertain.

name: Jakk
summary: A formally dressed pumpkin-headed creature sometimes described as a demon's familiar, with a face suited to autumn festivities.

name: Joker
summary: An enchanted playing card created through dark magical experiments, assigned to guard a tower against intruders.

name: Khalitzburg
summary: A knight's spirit remains imprisoned in armor after Glastheim's chivalry fell to Himmelmez's curse.

name: Magnolia
summary: An unhappy spirit linked to an unhatched Peco Peco egg, appearing as the bizarre union of egg and frying pan.

name: Mantis
summary: Despite its bladed limbs, this martial insect favors punches and kicks, even carrying a little fan.

name: Marduk
summary: A desert shaman associated with the curses that bind guardians to a king's tomb.

name: Marina
summary: An elastic jellyfish whose muscular tentacles serve as whips. It can endure brief excursions beyond its cool aquatic home.

name: Marine Sphere
summary: A drifting aquatic sphere with an explosive response to danger, making it useful and hazardous to alchemists.

name: Marionette
summary: A lesser demon occupies a puppet once used in royal performances, leaving a cursed doll suspended upon strings.

name: Marse
summary: A small squid-like creature that spins its body and lashes out with long, flexible tentacles.

name: Martin
summary: A burrowing mole that occasionally emerges from its underground home to search for food.

name: Matyr
summary: A magically created hound of the Sphinx, waking from dark mist when it catches an adventurer's scent.

name: Maya
summary: The ant colony's powerful queen usually remains within her damp, dark nest, emerging when invaders threaten it.

name: Medusa
summary: A snake-haired monster whose dreadful gaze is associated with petrification in accounts passed between adventurers.

name: Minorous
summary: An ox-headed hammer bearer dwelling deep in a labyrinth, hostile to anyone disturbing its isolation.

name: Moonlight Flower
summary: A bell-bearing fox demon commands fox followers, concealing a dangerous presence behind her youthful appearance.

name: Myst
summary: Living poisonous fog, thought to contain countless tiny organisms, drifts through darkness with a strangely window-like face.

name: Orc Skeleton
summary: Even stripped to its bones, this reanimated Orc Warrior continues the fighting that defined its life.

name: Orc Zombie
summary: Death has slowed this Orc Warrior and dulled its senses, but has failed to extinguish its fighting spirit.

name: Pasana
summary: A cursed soldier remains within the pyramid, bound beyond death to defend its former master.

name: Phen
summary: A slender blue fish recognized by its pointed snout and melancholy eyes, moving through the underwater world.

name: Phreeoni
summary: Its origins remain obscure, but the enormous tongue and unexpected power of this creature leave little room for complacency.

name: Piere
summary: A green worker ant devoted to Queen Maya, gathering supplies and scavenging for the colony.

name: Plankton
summary: Tiny drifting aquatic organisms form part of the food supply that sustains larger life beneath the water.

name: Rafflesia
summary: An aggressive, animate bush near Lighthalzen; whether magic or scientific interference caused its transformation remains uncertain.

name: Raydric
summary: A fallen castle guard's spirit inhabits its armor, maintaining a grim defense long after death.

name: Requiem
summary: Once an enslaved tomb-builder, this cursed figure carries a heavy coffin through the Sphinx and turns that burden against intruders.

name: Sandman
summary: A fairy formed from desert sand, sometimes mistaken in Morocc's folklore for the ghost of a traveler lost there.

name: Savage
summary: A forest boar that becomes formidable when angered, bringing its coarse tusks to bear against a threat.

name: Savage Babe
summary: A tiny young Savage whose appealing appearance has made it a familiar candidate for an adventurer's pet.

name: Skeleton Worker
summary: The resentment of a miner killed in an accident animates these bones, continuing a lifetime's labor beneath the earth.

name: Sohee
summary: A sorrowful spirit associated with Payon, whose tears conceal resentment that may suddenly turn fierce.

name: Stainer
summary: A colorful ladybug that preys on troublesome insects; its patterned shell is also valued as decoration.

name: Tarou
summary: A small pale-furred rodent at home in the darkness of culverts and mines.

name: Vitata
summary: A plump honey ant supplies its queen with honey and royal jelly, supporting the colony from within.

name: Zenorc
summary: This withdrawn, altered Orc survives in caves by scavenging scarce supplies, avoiding attention whenever possible.

name: Zerom
summary: An enslaved builder of the Sphinx remains bound by a curse, denied rest and compelled to guard Pharaoh's domain.

name: Whisper
summary: An apparition clothed in ghostly fabric, capable of slipping from sight as it haunts dark passages.

name: Nine Tail
summary: Forest magic has accumulated within this many-tailed fox. Stories claim it can assume human form, though that remains unconfirmed.

name: Bongun
summary: He is said to have accepted an undead existence so that he could continue protecting his beloved Munak.

name: Orc Archer
summary: A practiced Orc bowman brings ranged support to a people more commonly associated with close combat.

name: Orc Lord
summary: An intelligent Orc chief with a reputation for martial skill, favoring direct physical combat over conventional weapons.

name: Mimic
summary: A tempting treasure chest conceals a swift creature, turning an adventurer's appetite for riches into a dangerous encounter.

name: Wraith
summary: A cursed spirit hides in shadow, believing that stolen vitality can restore the life it has lost.

name: Alarm
summary: Magic animated this alarm clock to defend the Clock Tower, turning an ordinary timepiece into a tireless sentinel.

name: Rideword
summary: A living book inhabits magical libraries; whether it belongs to their security or merely infests them is uncertain.

name: Skeleton Prisoner
summary: A wrongfully accused prisoner's bones remain restless, carrying a grudge against the jailers who condemned them.

name: Zombie Prisoner
summary: A corpse from the castle prison returns with hatred that has spread beyond its captors to the living.

name: Mysteltainn
summary: The animated chain wrapped around this sword is the creature itself, wielding the blade as its borrowed body.

name: Executioner
summary: A living chain binds and controls a sword, transforming the weapon into the body of a roaming threat.

name: Sting
summary: An entity shaped from mud, capable of striking from farther away than its soft, earthen appearance suggests.

name: Cramp
summary: A hostile sewer rodent resembling Tarou, distinguished by a bite delivered through poisonous teeth.

name: Brilight
summary: For reasons still unclear, this ladybug grew unusually large and aggressive, retreating into dark places.

name: High Orc
summary: A formidable Orc distinguished by strength and intelligence, associated with raids on neighboring settlements.

name: Stem Worm
summary: An altered Worm Tail bears a stronger tendril, giving its otherwise familiar form greater reach and force.

name: Penomena
summary: A dangerous, mobile relative of Hydra that need not wait in one place for prey to approach.

name: Marin
summary: A Poring relative adapted to Lutie's perpetual winter, with little of its cousins' interest in discarded belongings.

name: Sasquatch
summary: A white-furred bear of the country around Lutie, known for its hostility toward passing travelers.

name: Christmas Cookie
summary: A mischievous fairy worker from Lutie's Toy Factory, bringing seasonal color to its busy workshops.

name: Cruiser
summary: A toy soldier equipped with a rifle stands guard over the factory where toys are made.

name: Myst Case
summary: Magic animates this toy box directly; unlike a Mimic, its movement is not attributed to a resident spirit.

name: Chepet
summary: The apparent girl is a puppet controlled by the strange doll she carries, attacking with burning matchsticks.

name: Gargoyle
summary: A winged lesser demon that threatens travelers from above, using a bow while airborne.

name: Raggler
summary: An injured seagull soldier gets around with a walking stick; healthier members of its kind serve as messengers.

name: Nereid
summary: A cave-dwelling worm with weak eyesight that relies upon scent to locate its prey.

name: Pest
summary: A poorly understood creature that covers its eyes as it launches a spinning attack.

name: Goblin Archer
summary: Goblin bowmen become especially dangerous together, concentrating their arrows on a shared target.

name: Gryphon
summary: Combining an eagle's head and wings with a lion's body, this magnificent beast can become a Royal Guard's mount.

name: Dark Frame
summary: A cursed mirror waits for someone to inspect their reflection, then reveals the threat behind its familiar surface.

name: Wild Rose
summary: A clever, troublesome cat recognizable by the large ribbon on its back; travelers whisper that it can be tamed.

name: Wind Ghost
summary: A skull-like apparition wrapped in a green cloak, feared for the strength of its magic.

name: Merman
summary: A warrior of the deep-sea tribes, encountered beneath the waves and in caves along the coast.

name: Cookie
summary: A playful fairy employed in Lutie's Toy Factory, as fond of tricks as the seasonal workers around it.

name: Aster
summary: A gentle sea-dwelling starfish, lending an unassuming shape to the varied creatures of the underwater world.

name: Carat
summary: A ball-riding demon in a clown's guise keeps trying to entertain Glastheim's inhabitants, despite its unreceptive undead audience.

name: Bloody Knight
summary: A once-valiant senior knight remains cursed within bloodstained armor, a dark remnant of the castle's former chivalry.

name: Clock
summary: An ancient wall clock became animate after long years among people, carrying familiar domestic features into the Clock Tower.

name: Clock Tower Manager
summary: A magical caretaker maintains Aldebaran's Clock Tower and defends both itself and the structure when threatened.

name: Alligator
summary: A humanoid alligator whose reputation is less hostile than that of the related Crocodile tribe.

name: Dark Lord
summary: A demon sovereign whose manifestations remain devastating even when the mortal world limits the power he can bring into it.

name: Orc Lady
summary: An Orc woman armed with a massive kitchen knife, quick to defend an Orc Baby in distress.

name: Megalith
summary: A mysterious island statue directs surrounding rocks against its enemies, animating an otherwise monumental stone form.

name: Alice
summary: A mechanical maid continues tending Glastheim Castle, turning her cleaning equipment against unwelcome intruders.

name: Raydric Archer
summary: A dead castle guard's spirit remains bound to armor, defending the ruins with a bow instead of a sword.

name: Greatest General
summary: A neglected village guardian is said to have turned sorrow into anger, lashing out at travelers while remaining rooted in place.

name: Stalactic Golem
summary: An advanced member of the golem family, its stone body evokes the cavern formations around it.

name: Tri Joint
summary: An ancient cave creature protected by a hard shell; fossil discoveries suggest its kind has existed for a long time.

name: Sage Worm
summary: Esteemed among its own kind, this unusually intelligent worm lends a scholarly presence to an otherwise unlikely body.

name: Kobold Archer
summary: A bow-using member of the wandering Kobold tribes, traveling in small groups through desert country.

name: Chimera
summary: A fire-breathing creature combining the features of lion, goat, and serpent into one unsettling body.

name: Maya Purple
summary: Queen Maya's mate helps defend the ant nest and its brood, reinforcing the colony's formidable guardians.

name: Wraith Dead
summary: A restless ghost wanders without direction, concealing a threatening mouth and teeth within its stomach.

name: Creamy Fear
summary: A far more dangerous Creamy relative whose familiar silhouette can mislead adventurers accustomed to the ordinary butterfly.

name: Panzer Goblin
summary: This inventive Goblin has acquired a powered jetpack, lending an improbable mechanical advantage to its airborne attacks.

name: Turtle General
summary: Turtle Island's leader is an agile veteran of twin-blade combat, defying the slowness travelers expect from turtles.

name: Assaulter
summary: A ninja warrior from Turtle Island throws an oversized shuriken with practiced accuracy.

name: Lord of the Dead
summary: An armored champion of death from the realm of Hel, bearing an immense lance and an imposing shield.

name: Poison Toad
summary: A poisonous toad that favors damp, dark surroundings, where its squat outline is easy to overlook.

name: Dullahan
summary: An inhabited suit of armor stalks Niflheim, carrying the presence of its unseen occupant through the realm of the dead.

name: Deviling
summary: A devilish member of the Poring family, retaining a jelly-like silhouette despite its darker nature.

name: Kraben
summary: Folklore describes a winged magician transformed into a creature with rice-pounding pestles for legs and a smaller pestle for a tail.

name: Metaling
summary: This metallic Poring relative scavenges loose objects like its softer cousins, despite a body associated with living machinery.

name: Pitman
summary: A dead miner's ghost haunts a rusting mine cart, unable to leave the tunnels where it continues to wander.

name: Ungoliant
summary: A formidable inhabitant of the Einbroch region, adding another hazard to the country surrounding its industrial city.

name: Teddy Bear
summary: A stuffed bear has become animate, turning a comforting toy into an unsettling encounter.

name: Anopheles
summary: A swarm of tiny blood-drinking insects attacks together, making its collective presence more dangerous than any single member.

name: Cecil Damon
summary: A former member of the Hunter Guild during its days in Payon's Archer Village, remembered for her place among its hunters.

name: Vesper
summary: A vast mechanical guardian roams Juperos's underground laboratory; accounts associate what remains inside it with Vesper Newton.

name: Orc Baby
summary: This young Orc carries its own axe and calls upon Orc Warrior and Orc Lady parents when it needs help.

name: Lady Tanee
summary: A female spirit associated with a banana tree, drawing upon stories of an alluring supernatural presence dwelling within the plant.

name: Kiel D-01
summary: Kiel Jr.'s first fourth-generation robot reworks the design of his own second-generation body with extensive modifications.

name: Alicel
summary: A third-generation Kiel Hyre robot trained at the academy to interact with people, part of a program sold to Rekenber.

name: Aliot
summary: A third-generation robot developed by the Kiel Hyre Foundation, educated among academy prototypes intended to learn human interaction.

name: Aliza
summary: A mechanical maid manages cleaning and supplies inside the Kiel Hyre Robot Factory, usually absorbed in her assigned work.

name: Ktullanux
summary: An ice beast deep within the Ice Cave was coerced by Sessrumnir priests into guarding a boy imprisoned there.

name: Stapo
summary: A stone-bodied member of the Poring family, giving the familiar bouncing form a mineral counterpart.

name: Magmaring
summary: Magma flows across the body of this Poring relative, replacing the familiar cool jelly with a volcanic appearance.

name: Golden Savage
summary: A Savage distinguished by an unusual golden coat, standing out from the ordinary boars of its family.

name: Banshee
summary: A restless spirit haunts the cursed monastery on Nameless Island, sharing the sorrowful atmosphere of its abandoned halls.

name: Entweihen Crothen
summary: An ambitious demon associated with Nacht Sieger, outwardly an adviser while seeking the chance to seize its superior's position.

name: Tatacho
summary: These shaggy creatures often sit motionless, rolling about when cold weather lowers their body temperature.

name: Nepenthes
summary: This unusual plant absorbs harmful minerals from the ground, leaving the soil beneath it unexpectedly fertile.

name: Nidhoggr's Shadow
summary: A manifestation of Nidhoggr's dark energy, giving tangible form to the shadow associated with the great dragon.

name: Headless Mule
summary: A fire-breathing headless mule draws upon Brazilian folklore about a cursed human forced into a terrifying animal form.

name: Scorpion
summary: A desert insect protected by a hard shell, carrying venom at the tip of its raised tail.

name: Abysmal Knight
summary: Once part of Glastheim's White Knight cavalry, this merciless rider belongs to the chivalry transformed by Himmelmez's curse.
